findings.problem: The prompt "to split" with the hint "cut or break into pieces" also fits dividir (the usual word for splitting something like a bill), cortar and romper, so it doesn't lead to partir alone.
findings.fix: hint: split something physical into pieces, like bread or a cake (not dividir, cortar or romper)

back.es: to split, to cut or break into pieces (also: to depart)
back.example: Do you cut / Will you cut the cake into eight pieces?

note: The example's English "Will you split" works as a request reading of the Spanish present-tense question.
